MS-SLSQP (rerun batch mpce\_slsqp): the time per run jumps from 3.1~s at $N=7$ to 16--22~s at $N\ge8$, independent of $r$; re-timed with single-threaded BLAS: $N=7$: 3.0~s (stored 3.0~s), $N=8$: 4.1~s (stored 13.9~s), $N=10$: 6.9~s (stored 20.3~s), $N=15$: 6.0~s (stored 19.7~s). $^{a}$Same method, runs of an earlier batch (fresh\_grid). n/r: not run. Total serial compute (sum of Seconds): 101.1 CPU-hours for the 36{,}190 records of the main study and 12.4 for the 11{,}640 records of the additional experiments; the runs were executed in four parallel worker processes, so the elapsed time of a study was about a quarter of its total.}
\end{table*}
